# fonts

The one font built into `mim`, for the canvas's text.

- `LiberationSans-Regular.ttf`: Liberation Sans 2.1.5, from https://github.com/liberationfonts,
  under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`LICENSE`). Unmodified: "Liberation" is a Reserved Font
  Name, so a subset or any other change would have to be renamed.
- Embedded into the binary by `runtime/canvas/CMakeLists.txt`.
